# anthropic_federation_issuers (Data Source)

Lists OpenID Connect (OIDC) federation issuers in the organization (`GET /v1/organizations/federation_issuers`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Whether to include archived federation issuers.

### Read-Only

- `issuers` (Attributes List) List of federation issuers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issuers))

<a id="nestedatt--issuers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `issuers`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the issuer was archived, or `null` if active.
- `check_jti` (Boolean) Whether single-use `jti` replay tracking is enforced.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the issuer was created.
- `id` (String) Unique tagged identifier (`fdis_...`).
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL.
- `jwks` (Attributes) JWKS configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--issuers--jwks))
- `max_jwt_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Maximum allowed JWT assertion lifetime in seconds.
- `name` (String) Slug name of the federation issuer.
- `type` (String) Object type (`federation_issuer`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the issuer was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--issuers--jwks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `issuers.jwks`

Read-Only:

- `ca_cert_pem` (String) Custom CA certificate PEM bundle, or `null`.
- `discovery_base` (String) Override base URL for OIDC discovery, or `null`.
- `type` (String) JWKS resolution strategy.
- `url` (String) Explicit JWKS endpoint URL, or `null`.
